text:
deploy-bot: Preflight eval triggered for release v2026.03.20-rc2. Reason: prompt-eval variance > threshold on summarizer_long suite (3/72 tests). Holding canary. See report: https://redwood/reports/3309876543

alice: looked at the report — noise clustered on long-thread summarizer after tokenizer change. delta ~ -7.2 on ROUGE-L-ish metric, distribution skewed. not obviously flakiness.

samir: @alice can you paste the failing examples? want to check if it's missing content or hallucination.

alice: pasted two failing outputs into the report, but here's one quick snippet:
```
ref: "Meeting notes: Discussed Q2 roadmap and action items: assign owners, timeline, risks."
old: "Key takeaways and action items assigned to the team."
new: "Highlights of the meeting." (drops explicit action items)
```

jordan: this looks like a user-visible regression — can't ship this to canary. propose pin to previous model for canary until triage/bisect completes. :warning:

maria: ops note — change window is 16:00-18:00 PT today. if we pin, need release notes update and rollback ticket before window closes. I can do the notes if we decide.

alice: quick triage shows the regression correlates with PR #4521 (tokenizer tweak). likely tokenization shift causing shorter context for tail-heavy prompts.

samir: two options IMO: 1) run an expanded eval (1k samples) targeting long-thread summarizer + random seeds to confirm; 2) quick revert/pin for canary while we bisect. prefer running expanded eval in parallel first.
jordan: running expanded eval takes time. product needs decision — pin now or risk canary. I'd rather pin to be safe.
maria: if pinning, we have to also update the release notes and the rollback runbook. I can draft the note: "Pinned summarizer model to v2026.03.19 for canary due to prompt-eval variance; investigating tokenizer impact."

product-desk: tagging product for visibility — please include expected user impact and mitigation steps in the note.
alice: kicked off expanded eval: `./scripts/run_prompt_eval --suite summarizer_long --samples 1000 --report out/3309876543.json`
deploy-bot: Eval job scheduled (job_id: eval-3309). I will post results to this thread when finished.

qa-bot: FYI automated hold activated: canary traffic scaled down to 10% and no new promotions until hold cleared.
jordan: timeline proposal: wait for expanded eval (ETA ~12m). if metric regression >5% on primary metric then pin; otherwise unhold and continue rollout. who owns the pin if triggered?
maria: ops will create the pin/rollback ticket and update release notes.

samir: I'll watch the eval and run a targeted bisect on tokenizer commits if regression persists.

product-desk: acknowledged. please include a short blurb for release notes and customer-facing FAQ if pinned.

alice: eval started — posting progress.

(threads will be updated by deploy-bot and qa-bot with results and any subsequent pins/rollbacks)
